build_footer_line: build a runtime footer line from user config, model, context tokens, and cwd for the gateway response
format_runtime_footer: format a runtime footer string showing model name, context percentage, and current working directory
resolve_footer_config: resolve the effective runtime footer config by merging global defaults with per-platform overrides from user config
review_home_relative_cwd: review the helper function that collapses a working directory path to use tilde notation for the home directory
summarize_model_short: summarize the helper function that strips the vendor prefix from a model identifier for display
